latHint: Think when owls and bats are awake.
pivHint: Jesus says the THIEF comes only to steal, kill and destroy. In 1 Thessalonians, the Lord's return comes like a THIEF in the ______.
winText: You found it. THIEF isn't just the one who comes to steal and destroy. Paul says the Lord's return will come like a THIEF in the NIGHT.
lossText: The word was NIGHT. THIEF was the pivot. In 1 Thessalonians 5:2, Paul says the Lord's return will come unexpectedly, like a THIEF in the NIGHT.
votdVerse: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
passageText: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture. The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
